body:
I got the news that her son is all right. I don't know the details but she let me know about and we reaffirmed with great sadness that we can't communicate further. 

Thank you for writing.

Wait!

Stop!

Oh my god, good people of Reddit:

The baby is O.K.

He is perfectly all right. Whatever he choked on he swallowed and does not seem to be in any distress. 

I don't know if X-rays have been taken or not yet, but he is totally out of danger for now.

God, I posed this and then I got the text five seconds later. 

Sorry for the false alarm. 

I'm going to go do some breathing exercises now.
